title: Terraform storage module: VPC-friendly consolidated EBS/EFS/S3 blueprint
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a single, opinionated Terraform module that provides a VPC-friendly storage surface for Private deployments: EBS volumes (for stateful instances), EFS (shared POSIX storage with access points and mount targets), and S3 buckets (object store with lifecycle & snapshot orchestration). The goal is a production-ready, upgradeable module with secure defaults (CMK encryption, restricted ACLs, bucket policies), automated snapshot lifecycle, health probes, and a well-documented migration/upgrade path for existing customer resources. Module must support private networking constraints (no public mount targets/ingress), cross-account access patterns for Dedicated control planes, and provide observability hooks (CloudWatch metrics, dashboards).
updates: 2025-09-18: RFC drafted outlining module scope, interfaces, and safety constraints. Decided to favor opinionated defaults (CMK, versioning enabled for buckets, EFS encryption at rest) and explicit opt-outs rather than opt-ins.

2025-09-24: Spike completed to validate EFS access points + mount targets in multi-AZ private subnets. Found race where mount-target creation sometimes stalls when subnet tagging is inconsistent; added idempotent retry logic to the examples and docs.

2025-09-30: Prototype Terraform module implemented with submodules: redwood_storage/ebs, redwood_storage/efs, redwood_storage/s3. Each submodule exposes a small set of variables (size, type, kms_key_id, private_subnet_ids, tags) and standardized outputs. Kept interface minimal to reduce upgrade surface.

2025-10-01: Security review kickoff. Decided to require customer-provided CMK for high-compliance teams; otherwise we create an account-scoped CMK with rotation enabled. Added policy templates for cross-account bucket access using IAM role ARNs.

2025-10-03: Health-check design accepted: lightweight Lambda probes run periodic mounts (EFS), attach/read/write (EBS via ephemeral EC2 task), and simple put/get for S3. Probes publish CloudWatch custom metrics and integrate with existing alerting playbooks. Open question: whether to bundle probe Lambdas in the module or provide a separate monitoring module.
comments: Ravi Patel (09/25): Review note - prefer explicit KMS key variable rather than generating keys implicitly for enterprise customers. Also flagged terraform provider version pinning.
Lena Cho (09/26): Design feedback - ensure EFS access points are created with least-privilege IAM principals and that mount targets are limited to supplied security groups only.
Marco Ruiz (09/29): Implementation note - added terratest cases for EFS mount + NFS handshake; found intermittent ENI allocation failures in small accounts, added backoff and increased timeouts.
SRE Team (10/02): Operational question - health probes must include detailed failure reasons to speed runbooks. Suggest embedding trace IDs and link to centralized dashboard in alert payloads.
